notes: Covers both SA and UAE. Integrations span Shopify, WooCommerce, RFID, and HR systems. Each integration project has its own scope and timeline — this is more of a portfolio than a single product. The IS project has no Estimate field, only Spent time — so 'unestimated' checks don't apply here. POS X integration architecture should be planned before Phase 1 ships, not after.
